description: This Java source file defines a ContentProvider subclass, XmlDocumentProvider, which exposes an XML document as a read-only ContentProvider. It parses XML documents (local resources or downloaded from the internet) into a Cursor, allowing other components to query and access XML data using XPath-like patterns for node selection and projection.

classes.name: XmlDocumentProvider
classes.description: A ContentProvider subclass that exposes XML document data as a Cursor, enabling XPath-like querying of XML content.

classes.name: XMLCursor
classes.description: An internal class extending MatrixCursor to parse an XML document into a Cursor format, supporting XPath-like node selection and projection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ContentProvider, returns true indicating successful creation.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Processes a query request, retrieves and parses the XML document (local or remote), and returns a Cursor over the selected XML nodes.

methods.name: getUriXmlPullParser
methods.description: Creates an XmlPullParser for an XML document accessible via a URL, downloading the content if necessary.

methods.name: getResourceXmlPullParser
methods.description: Creates an XmlPullParser for a local XML resource specified by a Uri.
